spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates how display-mode="icon-only" preserves UA-generated localized accessible names across locales while rejecting author aria-label spoofing and enforcing compositor occlusion/stability checks.

interactive.rationale: Visitors can switch capability element types (<microphone>, <camera>, <geolocation>), document locales (en, ja, de, es), and security threat scenarios (aria-spoof, occluded, layout shift).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card description: interactive accessibility tree & anti-spoofing verifier demonstrating localized screen-reader accessible names and occlusion checks.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers hostile aria-label override attempts, partial DOM overlay occlusion, and sub-500ms layout displacement.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/5107682460696576, W3C Media Capture HTML Elements security section, and explainer.

conformance.rationale: Verifies IDL displayMode reflection and localized accessible name computation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified locale switching, occlusion banner toggling, AXNode readout updates, and zero console or layout overflow errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits capability-a11y-security-probe assertion with activeCap, activeLang, trustedName, activeSec, and activationAllowed.

design_system.rationale: Uses only /public/styles.css variables, pairs background+color on all buttons and badges, and guarantees 44px minimum target heights.

accessibility.rationale: All toggle buttons use aria-pressed, the simulated capability icon updates its localized aria-label, and the status readout uses aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive auto-fit grid and contained hit-test stage work cleanly across 360x740 mobile and 1280x800 desktop viewports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Icon-only controls require an authoritative, unambiguous accessible name and non-visual state reporting.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Demonstrated how UA capability elements provide localized accessible names automatically in icon-only mode and exposed the AXTree node in a live region.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related interactive controls inside semantic <fieldset> and <legend> containers with 44px minimum hit areas.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped capability type, locale, and threat scenario toggles in fieldsets with min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure overlay stages and comparison panels remain within mobile viewport bounds without horizontal scrolling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Used overflow: hidden on the hit-test stage and auto-fit grid columns so 360px mobile viewports have zero horizontal overflow.

summary: Interactive accessibility tree and compositor anti-spoofing verifier for capability elements in display-mode="icon-only".
